summary: Completed testing of SESI #32 - Nilai Potongan & Potongan Yatim features. Verified Master Potongan screen displays value information correctly, orphan panel detection and cleanup functionality works, and backend POC tests pass 13/13. Main agent's implementation is solid.

WAJIB-1: Table headers include required columns 'Nilai' and 'Status Nilai'
WAJIB-2: Orphan card displays correctly with 1 orphan (CUT-JEPIT-JEDAI-NAVY-L)
WAJIB-2: Orphan details show correct information (kain asal: VFH6B-KAIN-174456, stok: 0 pcs, alasan: kain & order missing, status: aman dihapus)
WAJIB-3: Cleanup endpoint works correctly (POST /api/cutting/panels/cleanup removed 1 orphan)

Backend POC test_core_potongan_nilai_dan_yatim.py: 13/13 PASS
Backend gate verify_potongan_nilai_dan_yatim.py (INV-F37): 12/12 PASS
T1: Harga kain lahir dari penerimaan (rata-rata bergerak)
T2: Master potongan lahir saat start, menunjuk order & kain asal
T3: HPP potongan lahir SAAT progres (nilai kain keluar / pcs jadi)
T4: Harga kain = rata-rata bergerak setelah penerimaan kedua
T5: HPP potongan = RATA-RATA BERGERAK (tidak ditimpa)
T6: Kekekalan nilai (Σ nilai kain keluar == nilai stok potongan)
T7: Complete order - nilai benar, master tidak ditimpa
T8: Kain tanpa harga → potongan status 'unvalued' + pesan jelas
T9: Cancel order membersihkan master potongan yang belum dipakai
T10: Potongan yatim terdeteksi & bisa dibersihkan (idempoten)
T11: Potongan yatim berstok TIDAK dihapus + alasan disebut
T12: Daftar Master Potongan lengkap (nilai + asal + status + penanda yatim)
C1-C4: Static code checks pass (apply_progress_value, complete logic, cancel guard, UI elements)
C5-C11: Runtime checks pass (nilai berpindah, rata-rata bergerak, kekekalan nilai, unvalued handling, cleanup)
C12: No orphan panels left in database after all tests
